calm: He calleth his own sheep by name.
By God's grace, our church is growing. And as the Lord adds to our number, our care must keep up.
Every member receives a QR sticker for their Bible.
At the door, they simply hold it up to the camera. Each one is greeted by name, and checked in.
Some may prefer a fingerprint, or simply their face. Flock supports all three.
No lines. No logbooks. Our ushers are free to welcome people.
Flock shows the state of the flock,
and reminds us whose birthdays to pray for,
so the pastor and workers can visit those we missed.
